q: How many incidents are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents

q: How many SLA breaches happened in the last 7 days?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE sla_breached=1 AND opened_at >= datetime('now','-7 days')

q: How many P1 incidents are currently open or in progress?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE priority='P1' AND status IN ('Open','In Progress')

q: Which application has the most incidents?
sql: SELECT a.app_name FROM incidents i JOIN applications a ON a.app_id=i.app_id GROUP BY a.app_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Count incidents by priority.
sql: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) FROM incidents GROUP BY priority

q: What is the SLA breach rate percentage for P2 incidents?
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(sla_breached)/COUNT(*),2) FROM incidents WHERE priority='P2'

q: Which team owns the Tokenization Service?
sql: SELECT t.team_name FROM applications a JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id WHERE a.app_name='Tokenization Service'

q: How many SLA breaches does each team have?
sql: SELECT t.team_name, SUM(i.sla_breached) FROM incidents i JOIN applications a ON a.app_id=i.app_id JOIN teams t ON t.team_id=a.team_id GROUP BY t.team_name

q: How many times did the token_recovery job fail?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE job_name='token_recovery' AND status='FAILED'

q: What is the average duration in minutes of the daily_ingest job?
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(duration_min),2) FROM jobs WHERE job_name='daily_ingest'

q: Which engineer is assigned the most incidents?
sql: SELECT assigned_to FROM incidents GROUP BY assigned_to ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many incidents are assigned to Asha?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE assigned_to='Asha'

q: Total records processed by all jobs?
sql: SELECT SUM(records_processed) FROM jobs

q: How many high criticality applications are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications WHERE criticality='High'

q: Which location has the Platform Ops team?
sql: SELECT location FROM teams WHERE team_name='Platform Ops'

q: How many incidents were opened in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents WHERE opened_at >= datetime('now','-30 days')

q: How many breached P1 incidents does the EKS Gateway have?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incidents i JOIN applications a ON a.app_id=i.app_id WHERE a.app_name='EKS Gateway' AND i.priority='P1' AND i.sla_breached=1

q: Which job has the highest total retry count?
sql: SELECT job_name FROM jobs GROUP BY job_name ORDER BY SUM(retry_count) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many jobs ended with PARTIAL status?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs WHERE status='PARTIAL'

q: What is the resolve-within hours for P3?
sql: SELECT resolve_within_hours FROM sla_policies WHERE priority='P3'
